items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of headworks screening... The headworks includes an ultrasonic flow meter, mechanical screening, and grit removal.
The headworks includes an ultrasonic flow meter, mechanical screening, and grit removal.
The treatment system at the Facility consists of ... biological treatment with three sequencing batch reactors (SBR’s) that provide nitrification/denitrification...
The treatment system at the Facility consists of ... coagulation and flocculation...
The decant from the SBR’s flows to the intermediate storage basin to equalize batch flows and provide continuous flow to the four recirculating Dynasand filters.
The Facility uses a UV disinfection system consisting of two channels with three banks in each channel, each with 36 lamps.
Having previously used a chlorine disinfection system, the contact chamber is now maintained for use as emergency storage.

During periods of high influent flows, wastewater may bypass the mechanical screen and pass through a manual bar screen or be diverted to a 3 million gallon equalization basin and returned to the headworks as flows subside.
Until August 2016 the Discharger was adding hydrated lime slurry (calcium hydroxide) to the influent to increase the alkalinity and pH...
At the end of August 2016 the Discharger stopped using calcium hydroxide and started adding a caustic solution.
Sludge is aerobically digested in two digesters and dewatered by a belt filter press and sludge drying beds.

Solids are transported offsite for disposal as needed and a minimum of once per year.
As allowed by WDR Order 98-110, the effluent is discharged to a 66 million gallon storage reservoir (Holman Reservoir) where it is used for spray irrigation of 61 acres of pastureland.
